name: ojo
description: Prepare local websites for OJO optimization with @touchine/ojo: route non-OJO apps through conversion, validate prototypes and snapshots with export-native scripts, import authorized artifacts, and verify them through CLI/API readback. Local canvas startup and preview are disabled.

interface.longDescription: Use OJO to optimize an existing local website or app with @touchine/ojo >=1.0.9 <2.0.0. Start non-OJO projects with conversion preflight and a behavior-preserving workspace based on a real export; validate builds and default snapshots with the export's own scripts, import to an explicit authorized target, and verify artifacts through CLI/API readback. Preserve proposal-before-design-change approval and analysis-only limits. Missing project IDs do not block source preflight. Remote proposals and approved execution use verified chat/query commands. Local canvas startup and localhost preview are disabled, so the plugin never requests an irise-web checkout or claims canvas visual verification.
defaultPrompt: 使用 OJO 优化当前本地项目：先检查兼容性，必要时转换，并上传到我指定的 OJO 项目；先给出优化方案，等我确认后再修改页面。
让 OJO 为指定项目先输出优化方案，读取实际回复并等我确认后，再发送执行请求。
Download this prototype workspace and validate its manifests without starting a local canvas.
